description: This file defines a web search provider plugin for Perplexity, including configuration resolution, API interaction functions, schema creation, and plugin registration logic.

methods.name: resolvePerplexityConfig
methods.description: Resolves the Perplexity configuration from a search config record.

methods.name: inferPerplexityBaseUrlFromApiKey
methods.description: Infers the base URL hint ('direct' or 'openrouter') from the API key prefix.

methods.name: resolvePerplexityApiKey
methods.description: Resolves the API key and its source from environment variables or configuration.

methods.name: resolvePerplexityBaseUrl
methods.description: Determines the base URL for Perplexity API based on configuration and environment.

methods.name: resolvePerplexityModel
methods.description: Resolves the model name to use for Perplexity API.

methods.name: isDirectPerplexityBaseUrl
methods.description: Checks if the base URL points directly to Perplexity's API endpoint.

methods.name: resolvePerplexityRequestModel
methods.description: Adjusts the model name based on whether the base URL is direct.

methods.name: resolvePerplexityTransport
methods.description: Determines the transport method ('search_api' or 'chat_completions') based on configuration.

methods.name: extractPerplexityCitations
methods.description: Extracts citation URLs from Perplexity search response data.

methods.name: runPerplexitySearchApi
methods.description: Performs a native search API request to Perplexity.

methods.name: runPerplexitySearch
methods.description: Performs a chat completion search request to Perplexity.

methods.name: resolveRuntimeTransport
methods.description: Resolves the runtime transport method based on configuration and environment.

methods.name: createPerplexitySchema
methods.description: Creates a JSON schema for search parameters based on transport type.

methods.name: createPerplexityToolDefinition
methods.description: Creates a tool definition object for Perplexity search, including description, schema, and execution logic.

methods.name: createPerplexityWebSearchProvider
methods.description: Registers the Perplexity web search provider plugin with its configuration and methods.
